remarks:
OPEN HOUSES! SAT 10/10 AND SUNDAY 10/11 1-3PM! Don't miss this one! Sought after neighborhood, classic details, inviting spaces & plenty of room to grow! This spacious 4-bedroom, 1.5-bath home with exterior brick accents in a demand neighborhood welcomes you with beautiful hardwood floors, a lovely front entry and a practical side entrance. The bright eat-in kitchen features plentiful white cabinetry, granite counters, subway tile backsplash, recessed lighting & included appliances! A separate breakfast nook with built-ins makes a delightful spot for morning coffee. Hardwood floors continue into the formal dining room, where classic wainscoting & crown molding create a beautiful setting for gatherings. French doors lead to the back family room with sliding doors opening to the backyard, extending your entertaining space outdoors! The generous living room offers abundant natural light & a wood-burning fireplace with a wooden mantel. A half bath near the side entrance completes the first floor.

Upstairs, find 3 spacious bedrooms with ample closets, including one with a walk-in closet & laundry chute! The beautifully remodeled full bath features a deep soaking tub, tiled floor & tub surround, glass door, updated vanity, mirror & lighting. A private 4th bedroom situated on the third floor with ceiling fan, along with unfinished attic space for additional storage.

The full basement adds even more versatility with a finished area featuring built-in shelving—ideal for a playroom, game nights, football gatherings or a dedicated office! Forced air/Central air, glass block windows, an updated electrical panel & a separate laundry area with included washer & dryer add to the appeal.

Enjoy outdoor dining & relaxing on the stamped concrete patio and walkway with an awning, plus plenty of green space for gardening & play. A hard-to-find 2-car garage with an opener and concrete driveway rounds out this wonderful property! Close to shopping & everyday amenities, with Thruway access just minutes away.
